hypothesis: Under latent GRM no-DIF with impact -0.5, evaluate dataset-level Holm-FWER separately for three procedures; observed-score and latent-conditional nulls are not mathematically equivalent.
raw_source_status: No raw response matrices in p2 records; regenerate from recorded generator/seeds, do not present old summaries as paired raw data
observed_score_matching: All ten coded item scores, studied item included; no purification. Use the production item functions and recompute multiplicity on exactly the two tested items.
observed_nulls: Mantel conditional-score association (1 df), ordinal LR group plus score-interaction omnibus (2 df)
grm_null: Fixed anchors invariant; test joint a and all thresholds (4 df). Reference N(0,1); focal mean/SD free. Native production gates unchanged, GH61 with GH81 audit.
primary: Holm FWER per dataset across the same two items
secondary: BH FDR (equals BH FWER under this complete null)
failure_policy: Any missing item p, nonconvergence, singular information, quadrature failure, nested-LR violation or 90-second GRM timeout makes that whole method/dataset invalid. Save all outcomes. Conditional metrics use valid datasets; failure-robust event bounds code unknown failures as 0/1 for best/worst cases. Paired differences use complete pairs, with missing-pair range reported.
seed_rule: first_seed + replication_index; first ten match existing ordinal null/impact p2 seed design
primary_interval: Exact Clopper-Pearson at 1-0.05/3 per method; Bonferroni joint >=95% across three primary-method assessments
required_n_rule: Smallest R such that the maximum distance from k/R to either exact CP endpoint, for every k=0..R at confidence 1-0.05/3, is <=0.02. Compute before fitting; do not assume 400.
decision_rule: Only a completed precision-planned main experiment may support scoped control if failure-robust upper bound <=0.05; inflation if lower bound >0.05; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Pilot is always diagnostic / NOT CERTIFIED.
expansion_rule: No expansion if any pilot method is invalid, pilot incomplete, or projected full required-R cost exceeds the remaining fixed 600-second calibration budget. Otherwise continue the same preregistered seeds once, no retries or alternative starts.
mechanism_diagnostic: No-fit known-GRM convolution: E[item|observed total,group] at GH61/GH81 for P09/P10, impact=-0.5 and impact=0 control. Report full curves/probabilities and step differences; no post-hoc pass cutoff.
scope: Balanced 500/500, J10 C4, two tested items, eight oracle fixed anchors, normal theta, no true DIF; no power, purification, R comparison or general certification
